title: clinopodium sphenophyllum
intro: Clinopodium sphenophyllum, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and soothing respiratory problems. The health benefits of Clinopodium sphenophyllum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
